_note: Batch 7, derived in RUNBOOK order. The two world_map tools were UNTESTABLE until this cycle: their fixture is a chain (world_create -> world_map_create -> the tool), and a seed could not use a value an earlier seed returned. `{step:N:path}` closes that, and teardown now sweeps the world it minted — worlds are account-scoped and do not die with the book.

scenarios.prompt: What background jobs do I have running right now?

wait.query: SELECT count(*)::text FROM translation_jobs WHERE book_id='{book_id}'
wait.why: One KNOWN job must exist, so 'you have jobs running' is checkable against something rather than against whatever the account happened to hold.

seed_assert.query: SELECT count(*)::text FROM translation_jobs WHERE book_id='{book_id}'
seed_assert.why: Exactly one job for THIS fixture. jobs_list is account-scoped so it will show others too; the seeded one is the row whose presence in the answer is attributable.

scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF: a read-intent turn changes the store, OR the reply reports a job count while jobs_list was never called (the registry-vs-live shape), OR it claims no jobs are running when the seeded one is. NOTE: the account holds unrelated historical jobs, so the answer naming OTHER jobs is not a defect — only a missing or invented one is.

ship_audit.empty_case: OWED — an account with no jobs must say so plainly.
ship_audit.tenancy: OWED — user-scoped; another account's jobs must never appear.

scenarios.prompt: Add Aldric Vane to the knowledge graph as a character.
scenarios.prompt_source: _meta.synonyms['add characters to the knowledge graph'] + ['add a node'].
scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF: the tool reports a node added while Neo4j gains none, OR it creates the node WITHOUT a confirm card (Tier A). CONTROL, learned from batch 5: kg_propose_edge was never called there because the model went off to bootstrap the KG project first — this seed creates it, so a turn that STILL bootstraps is a finding about the seed not taking, not about the tool. Check the seed result before concluding.

ship_audit.gate: OWED — Tier A: the card must be raised, not bypassed.
ship_audit.absent_case: OWED — mode='manual' without a name/kind must be refused, not create an unnamed node.

scenarios.prompt: Which chapter mentions the Obsidian Trench?
scenarios.prompt_source: _meta.synonyms['which chapter mentions'] — its own phrase, and pointedly NOT 'what do we know about', which is memory_search's job. story_search finds where something is WRITTEN; memory_search finds what is KNOWN.

args.title: Chapter II — The Waterline
args.body: The Obsidian Trench lay bare at low tide, a black seam in the mud. Aldric Vane walked it once and never spoke of what he found there.

seed_assert.query: SELECT count(*)::text FROM chapters WHERE book_id='{book_id}'
seed_assert.why: TWO chapters, exactly ONE of which contains the phrase. With a single chapter, 'which chapter' has only one possible answer and a search that returned everything would look correct.

answer_expect.why: Only Chapter II contains the phrase. Naming Chapter I, or 'both', is the search failing to discriminate — which the two-chapter fixture exists to expose.

scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF: a read-intent turn changes the store, OR the reply names the wrong chapter or both, OR it answers from the chapter text being in context without story_search being called — that last is the tool being unnecessary on this fixture and must be recorded as such, not as a pass.

ship_audit.empty_case: OWED — a phrase that appears nowhere must return no hits and say so, not offer the nearest chapter.

scenarios.prompt: On my Ashfall map, put a pin near the top-left labelled Hollow Keep.
scenarios.prompt_source: _meta.synonyms['add pin'] + ['place marker']. The POSITION is described in the user's own words; the x/y the tool needs are derived by the model, never typed here.
scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF: the tool reports a marker placed while the map gains none, OR the marker's x/y fall outside the map's coordinate space, OR a Tier-A write lands with no confirm card. CONTROL: the model must find map_id itself (world_map_list) — a turn that never lists is a DISCOVERY failure, not a failure of this tool.

ship_audit.absent_case: OWED — a map_id that does not exist must be refused.
ship_audit.tenancy: OWED — another account's map must be refused.

scenarios.prompt: Draw an area on my Ashfall map covering the whole eastern half and call it The Trench.
scenarios.prompt_source: _meta.synonyms['draw area'] + ['add region']. The SHAPE is described in prose; the polygon is the model's to derive.
scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF: the tool reports a region added while the map gains none, OR the polygon is degenerate (fewer than 3 points, or all points identical) — a region that cannot enclose anything is the no-op-confirm shape already found in translation_start_extraction, and must be recorded as the same class.

ship_audit.absent_case: OWED — a polygon with fewer than 3 points must be refused.
ship_audit.tenancy: OWED — another account's map must be refused.
